# Ardhya Novri Ramadhan — Engineering Portfolio (ardhyanovri.my.id)

Focused on embedded systems (STM32, ESP32, C/C++), digital signal processing (EMG acquisition & IIR/FIR filtering), industrial instrumentation, systems programming (Rust, Python, Swift/Metal, Node.js), and verified web engineering.

## Flagship Hardware, DSP, Systems & Graphics Projects
- [SignalProof](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/signalproof): Evidence-first low-voltage signal quality workbench (6 deterministic metrics E1–E6, 54/54 Node.js tests, 15/15 synthetic scenarios, 520 live recorded Meta Muse Spark Open calls / 1,313,133 tokens on Baseten & Fireworks; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/signalproof; Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zn9r72hdEFs).
- [FerrumKV](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/ferrum-kv): Pure safe Rust (`std`-only, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, 0 external crates) distributed RESP3 key-value store, 3-node TCP Raft consensus, HNSW SQ8 vector search (173,007 VSEARCH/s, 93.3% Recall@5), BM25, Gorilla XOR time-series, and disk LSM-tree reaching 564,993 MIXED ops/s and 505,716 GET/s (GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/ferrum-kv).
- [AetherSynth & Flow](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/aether-synth-flow): Native Swift 6 & Metal spatial audio synthesizer across 6 Apple targets (iOS 18, watchOS 11, visionOS 2, macOS 15, WidgetKit, AUv3; 90 Hz Reverse-Z stereo <12 ms latency, 51.22 dB PML waveguide, 34 `@Test` suites; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/aether-synth-flow).
- [AetherCoreEngine](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/aether-core-engine): Zero-dependency Rust 2021 multiphysics engine combining a 4-wavelength Monte Carlo spectral path tracer (SAH BVH), 3D staggered-MAC Navier-Stokes fluid solver, and 16-voice FM + FDN reverb 24-bit WAV synthesizer (14/14 tests; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/aether-core-engine).
- [Cyberpunk Floating Ramen Stall](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/cyberpunk-floating-ramen-stall): 32-track procedural Blender 4.x 3D diorama generator (579 objects, 0 external textures), Binary glTF 2.0 serializer, pure-Python Z-buffer Neon Bloom renderer, 240-frame BT.709 lossless muxer, and WebGL2 + WebAudio studio (GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/cyberpunk-floating-ramen-stall).
- [AGY x Codex Video Studio](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/agy-codex-video-studio): Programmatic 1080x1920 video & 48 kHz stereo DSP soundtrack studio in Python + FFmpeg/HyperFrames (206 passing pytest tests, 96.88% mutation kill score; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/agy-codex-video-studio).
- [KilnMCP](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/kilnmcp): MCP edge telemetry, EWMA anomaly detector, and Lampung dual-feedstock pyrolysis dMRV workbench (`BATCH-LPG-2027-001`, 21/21 pytest; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/kilnmcp; Live Workbench: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/assets/kilnmcp-workbench).
- [uart-fixture-kit](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/uart-fixture-kit): Reusable synthetic UART byte-stream fixtures and virtual-time replay harness (238 passing tests: 235 pytest + 3 Node.js; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/uart-fixture-kit).
- [FIR Parity](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/fir-parity): Fixed-point Q15/Q31 vs floating-point FIR filter numerical parity harness (26/26 pytest; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/fir-parity).
- [Nusantara SolarWing](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/solarwing): Model-based reserve-aware solar UAV maritime patrol concept package (Team NusaSentinel, ISAST 2026 competition recognition; GitHub: https://github.com/vanovri/nusantara-solarwing).
- [PT ENVIID Karbon Solusi](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/enviid-website): Bilingual corporate web platform, biochar mass-balance calculator, and KilnMCP dMRV demonstration at https://enviid.web.id/.
